author: Erik Columbia
title: Spring "Tag Sale" returning to Manlius Senior Activity Centre - NewsBreak
text:
By Erik Columbia ,
12 hours ago
(WSYR-TV0 — The Manlius Senior Activity Centre is a place for seniors, 55-and-older, to find connection and peace.
Whether it be cards, community, or a good meal, those who are members find value inside those walls.
For the senior centre to continue, they need funding and the bi-annual tag sale is their biggest fundraiser. Kristin Rogers and Brittini Hastings joined Bridge Street to preview the sale and some of the goings-on at the Manlius Senior Activity Centre.
Items you can find at the spring tag sale:
Jewelry Home decor Artwork Kitchenware Purses Collectables Linens Toys and Games Holiday Decorations The Spring Tag Sale begins Friday, May 1st. It’s their preview night, and it costs $10 to shop from 6pm-7pm. The sale’s final day is Saturday, May 2nd from 9am to 1:30pm, and there is no entry fee.
For more information, head to ManliusSeniors.org .
